verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports show Ollama's own CLI downloading models ('ollama pull'), removing them ('ollama rm') and running them ('ollama run'), and users single out model management as a strength. There is no evidence of searching models from the command line, and the first-party docs in the pack never document these CLI subcommands; the REST API for managing models is a separate interface. missing for 10: CLI model search, first-party CLI documentation of pull/list/rm, other management commands (list, show, copy).

support.subject: As a developer, I can search, download, and manage models from a command-line interface

citations.quote: One 'ollama pull' and it's available. Underwhelming? 'ollama rm'.
combined with simple 'ollama pull model'—very convenient
llama.cpp does almost everything ollama does better except model management
